questions.stem: 近年來，大片森林已被野火（wildfires）燒毀，而野火在炎熱乾燥的天氣裡特別容易發生。
questions.answer: In recent years, vast areas of forest have been destroyed by wildfires, which are especially likely to start in hot and dry weather.
accepted_answers: Recently, large areas of forest have been burned down by wildfires, which tend to break out especially in hot, dry weather.
In recent years, many large forests have been destroyed by wildfires, which occur most easily in hot and dry weather.

patterns: 非限定關係子句（補充說明野火：…, which …）
完成式被動（已被野火燒毀）

questions.stem: 因此，定期清除林地上的枯枝落葉，普遍被認為是預防野火（wildfires）最有效的方法之一。
questions.answer: Therefore, clearing dead branches and leaves from forests regularly is widely recognized as one of the most effective strategies for preventing wildfires.
accepted_answers: Therefore, removing dead branches and fallen leaves from the forest floor regularly is generally believed to be one of the best ways to prevent wildfires.
Therefore, clearing away dead branches and leaves in forests on a regular basis is widely regarded as one of the most effective ways to prevent wildfires.

patterns: 被動語態（普遍被認為是…）
動名詞片語當主詞（定期清除林地上的枯枝落葉）

1.explanation_zh: 「近年來…已被野火燒毀」是到現在為止的結果，用現在完成式被動 have been destroyed by wildfires；「大片森林」是 vast／large areas of forest。後半句補充說明野火，用非限定關係子句 , which are especially likely to start in hot and dry weather；「容易發生」是可能性，用 be likely to／tend to，不說 easy to happen。weather 不可數，不加 a。
evidence: 大片森林已被野火（wildfires）燒毀
而野火在炎熱乾燥的天氣裡特別容易發生
1.strategy_zh: 看到「近年來」「已被」先想到 have been p.p.；「而野火…」是對野火的補充，用逗號＋which。
hints: 切成四段：大片森林／已被野火燒毀／在炎熱乾燥的天氣裡／特別容易發生
標的詞彙：forest（森林）、destroy（摧毀）、especially（特別）、weather（天氣）
句型框架：In recent years, S + have been p.p. + by N, which + be especially likely to VR …

2.explanation_zh: 主詞是「定期清除林地上的枯枝落葉」這個動作，寫成動名詞片語 clearing dead branches and leaves from forests regularly，動名詞主詞視為單數，所以用 is。「普遍被認為是」是被動 is widely recognized／regarded as。「最有效的方法之一」是 one of the most effective strategies／ways（one of the + 最高級 + 複數名詞），「預防野火」用 for preventing wildfires 或 to prevent wildfires 修飾前面的名詞。
evidence: 定期清除林地上的枯枝落葉
普遍被認為是預防野火（wildfires）最有效的方法之一
2.strategy_zh: 主詞先寫成 V-ing 片語並確認單數動詞；再套 be widely recognized as one of the most … strategies for V-ing。
hints: 切成四段：定期清除林地上的枯枝落葉／普遍被認為是／預防野火／最有效的方法之一
標的詞彙：clear（清除）、regularly（定期地）、branch（樹枝）、prevent（預防）、effective（有效的）、strategy（方法、策略）
句型框架：V-ing … + is widely recognized as + one of the most + adj. + N(複數) + for V-ing …

references: In recent years, vast areas of forest have been destroyed by wildfires, which are especially likely to start in hot and dry weather.
Recently, large areas of forest have been burned down by wildfires, which tend to break out especially in hot, dry weather.
In recent years, many large forests have been destroyed by wildfires, which occur most easily in hot and dry weather.

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「大片」指面積，用 vast／large areas of forest；piece 是「一塊、一片」小東西。
很多區域，areas 要用複數。

accepted: have been burned down by wildfires
have been burnt down by wildfires

common_errors.explanation_zh: 完成式被動是 have been + p.p.，been 不能省。

common_errors.wrong: were destroyed by wildfires in recent years
common_errors.right: have been destroyed by wildfires in recent years
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「近年來…已被」表示到現在為止的結果，用現在完成式被動。

accepted: when the weather is hot and dry

common_errors.wrong: in a hot and dry weather
common_errors.explanation_zh: weather 是不可數名詞，不加 a。

accepted: which are especially likely to start
which tend to break out especially
which are particularly likely to break out
which are especially likely to happen

common_errors.wrong: which are especially easy to happen
common_errors.right: which are especially likely to happen
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「容易發生」是可能性高，用 be likely to happen；easy to happen 不是英文的說法。

common_errors.wrong: that are especially likely to start
common_errors.right: which are especially likely to start
common_errors.explanation_zh: 逗號後的非限定關係子句不能用 that。

traps.literal_error: wildfires, which are especially easy to happen in hot and dry weather
traps.explanation_zh: 「容易發生」不是 easy to happen（easy 指做起來容易）；表示可能性高要用 be likely to happen、tend to break out 或 occur easily。

traps.literal_error: In recent years, vast areas of forest were destroyed by wildfires.
traps.explanation_zh: 「近年來…已被」說的是一直延續到現在的結果，要用現在完成式被動 have been destroyed，不用過去式。

1.restructuring_zh: 「而野火在…特別容易發生」不另起一句，用非限定關係子句補充說明 wildfires；「容易發生」改用 be likely to happen／tend to break out。

references: Therefore, clearing dead branches and leaves from forests regularly is widely recognized as one of the most effective strategies for preventing wildfires.
Therefore, removing dead branches and fallen leaves from the forest floor regularly is generally believed to be one of the best ways to prevent wildfires.
Therefore, clearing away dead branches and leaves in forests on a regular basis is widely regarded as one of the most effective ways to prevent wildfires.

removing dead branches and fallen leaves from the forest floor regularly
clearing away dead branches and leaves in forests on a regular basis
regularly clearing dead branches and leaves from forests
regularly removing dead branches and leaves from the forest floor

common_errors.wrong: Therefore, regularly clear dead branches and leaves from forests is
common_errors.right: Therefore, regularly clearing dead branches and leaves from forests is
common_errors.explanation_zh: 動詞片語當主詞要改成動名詞 clearing。
「枯枝」是 dead branches；「落葉」是已經掉下的葉子 fallen leaves（falling 是正在掉落）。
動名詞片語當主詞視為單數，用 is。

common_errors.explanation_zh: prevent 直接接受詞；prevent sb from V-ing 才有 from。
介系詞 for 後面接動名詞 preventing（或改用 to prevent）。

one of the most effective ways
one of the most effective methods

common_errors.right: one of the most effective strategies
common_errors.explanation_zh: effective 是多音節形容詞，最高級是 most effective。

traps.zh: 定期清除林地上的枯枝落葉
traps.literal_error: Therefore, regularly clear dead branches and leaves from forests is widely recognized as …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文直接拿「定期清除…」這個動作當主詞；英文要改成動名詞片語 clearing … regularly，動詞原形不能當主詞。

traps.literal_error: removing dry branches and falling leaves
traps.explanation_zh: 「枯枝落葉」是複合概念：枯掉的樹枝是 dead branches，掉在地上的葉子是 fallen leaves；照字面寫 dry、falling 意思不精確。

bonus.text: Nothing is more effective in preventing wildfires than regularly clearing dead branches and fallen leaves from forests.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用「否定詞＋比較級」Nothing is more effective … than … 表達最高級的意思，語氣更強烈。

2.restructuring_zh: 「定期清除林地上的枯枝落葉」這個動作當主詞，英文改成動名詞片語（視為單數）；「普遍被認為是」用被動 is widely recognized as／is widely considered (to be)。

1.translation: In recent years, large areas of forest have been destroyed by wildfires, which are especially likely to occur in hot and dry weather.
1.explanation_zh: 「近年來」配現在完成式；「已被燒毀」用現在完成被動 have been destroyed（也可 burned）；「而野火…特別容易發生」補充說明 wildfires，用非限定關係子句 which are especially likely to occur。

2.translation: Therefore, regularly clearing dead branches and fallen leaves from the forest floor is widely regarded as one of the most effective ways to prevent wildfires.
2.explanation_zh: 動名詞片語當主詞（單數動詞 is）；「普遍被認為是」用 is widely regarded as（也可 considered）；「最有效的方法之一」用 one of the most effective ways to…（最高級＋複數名詞）。

1.translation: In recent years, large areas of forest have been destroyed by wildfires, which are especially likely to occur in hot, dry weather.
1.explanation_zh: 「近年來」搭配現在完成式被動 have been destroyed；「大片森林」譯為 large areas of forest；「野火在炎熱乾燥的天氣裡特別容易發生」用非限定關係子句 which are especially likely to occur。

2.translation: Therefore, regularly clearing dead branches and leaves from the forest floor is widely considered one of the most effective ways to prevent wildfires.
2.explanation_zh: 「定期清除林地上的枯枝落葉」用動名詞片語當主詞（動名詞當主詞，動詞用單數 is）；「普遍被認為是」用 is widely considered；「最有效的方法之一」用 one of the most effective ways to V。
